description:
Spacious Detached Family Home nestled in a semi-rural location, offering a generous living room with patio doors leading to a delightful conservatory. The property features a modern dining kitchen equipped with stylish Thwaites Holme kitchen units, perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying family meals. Upstairs, you'll find four well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom, providing ample space for a growing family.

Additionally, the house benefits from an integral garage and ample off-street parking, ensuring convenience for multiple vehicles.

This charming property combines comfort and functionality, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle. Don't miss the chance to make this wonderful home your own.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing and explore the potential of this fantastic property.

Directions From Carlisle city centre head east on Warwick Road passing over the M6. Midway along the dual carriageway turn right into Scotby. Follow the road into the heart of the village and just after passing the shop on the right hand side turn right into Nightingale Court.
